doc: A coarse 16x512 float32 grid (512 rows: the height of the production back-trace grid at structure_width 1024) upsampled to a tall, narrow 8x2048 target: the target grid MUST be built in float64 (grid_dirs(width, height, float64), as the function does). With a float32 target the latitude comes from arcsin of a z that is quantized at 6e-8, which is ill-conditioned in the rows just outside the pole clamp (d lat = d z / cos lat, and one coarse row is only 6e-3 rad): measured, the all-float32 target pipeline misses this output by 5.3e-04 and 6709 of 49152 components fall outside the tolerance, while a float64 pipeline without the final rounding to float32 differs by 3.0e-08 (half a float32 ulp). Tolerance 1e-5 relative + 1e-6 absolute (the golden.store default: at least 30x the float64 spread, and 300x for components near 1, and well below the float32-target error). The other upsample cases are too small to tell the two apart (their coarse grids have at most 16 rows).
